name: Economics
description: Scarcity and choice, demand and supply, production, market structures, money and banking, national income, public finance, international trade and the structure of the Nigerian economy, aligned to WAEC, NECO and JAMB.

topics.name: Basic Economic Problems
topics.summary: Why every society must choose: scarcity, scale of preference, opportunity cost and the systems used to allocate resources.

subtopics.name: Scarcity and Choice
subtopics.summary: Unlimited wants against limited resources, and how a scale of preference forces choice.

objectives.text: Define economics, scarcity, wants and resources
Explain why scarcity makes choice unavoidable
Draw up a scale of preference and rank competing wants

subtopics.name: Opportunity Cost
subtopics.summary: The next best alternative forgone, and how the production possibility curve shows the cost of choosing.

objectives.text: Define opportunity cost as the next best alternative forgone
Calculate opportunity cost from a scale of preference or a production schedule
Interpret a production possibility curve and its shifts

subtopics.name: Economic Systems
subtopics.summary: Capitalism, socialism and the mixed economy, and where Nigeria fits.

objectives.text: State the three basic economic questions every system must answer
Compare capitalism, socialism and the mixed economy
Explain why Nigeria is described as a mixed economy

topics.name: Demand and Supply
topics.summary: How buyers and sellers interact to set price and quantity, and how responsive each side is to price changes.

subtopics.name: Demand
subtopics.summary: The law of demand, demand schedules, the determinants of demand and its exceptions.

objectives.text: State and explain the law of demand
Read and interpret a demand schedule
Distinguish a change in quantity demanded from a change in demand
Identify types of demand and exceptions to the law of demand

subtopics.name: Supply
subtopics.summary: The law of supply, supply schedules, determinants of supply and joint supply.

objectives.text: State and explain the law of supply
Read and interpret a supply schedule
List the determinants of supply and the exceptions to the law

subtopics.name: Market Equilibrium and Price Control
subtopics.summary: Where demand meets supply, how shortages and surpluses arise, and what price control does.

objectives.text: Determine equilibrium price and quantity from a schedule
Explain how excess demand and excess supply push price back to equilibrium
Analyse the effects of maximum and minimum price legislation

subtopics.name: Elasticity of Demand and Supply
subtopics.summary: Measuring responsiveness: price, income and cross elasticity, and why it matters for revenue and tax.

objectives.text: Calculate price elasticity of demand and interpret its value
Calculate income and cross elasticity of demand
Calculate price elasticity of supply
Relate elasticity to total revenue and to tax incidence

topics.name: Theory of Production
topics.summary: The factors of production, how costs and revenue behave as output grows, and the effects of scale.

subtopics.name: Factors of Production
subtopics.summary: Land, labour, capital and the entrepreneur, their rewards and their characteristics.

objectives.text: Identify the four factors of production and their rewards
Describe the characteristics of each factor of production
Explain division of labour, specialisation and their limitations

subtopics.name: Cost and Revenue
subtopics.summary: Fixed, variable, average and marginal cost; total, average and marginal revenue; and the profit-maximising rule.

objectives.text: Distinguish fixed cost from variable cost
Compute total, average and marginal cost from a cost schedule
Compute total, average and marginal revenue and locate maximum profit
Explain the law of diminishing returns

subtopics.name: Scale of Production
subtopics.summary: Internal and external economies of scale, diseconomies, and the optimum size of a firm.

objectives.text: Define economies and diseconomies of scale
Distinguish internal from external economies of scale
Explain localisation and the location of industry

topics.name: Market Structures
topics.summary: How the number of firms, product differences and barriers to entry shape price and output decisions.

subtopics.name: Perfect Competition
subtopics.summary: The benchmark market: many price-taking firms selling an identical product.

objectives.text: State the assumptions of perfect competition
Explain why a perfectly competitive firm is a price taker
Apply the MC equals MR rule to find equilibrium output

subtopics.name: Monopoly
subtopics.summary: A single seller with no close substitute: barriers to entry, price making and price discrimination.

objectives.text: State the features and sources of monopoly power
Explain price discrimination and the conditions for it
Evaluate the merits and demerits of monopoly and its control

subtopics.name: Monopolistic Competition and Oligopoly
subtopics.summary: Product differentiation, advertising, interdependence and price rigidity in real-world markets.

objectives.text: Describe the features of monopolistic competition
Describe the features of oligopoly, including collusion and price rigidity
Compare the four market structures on price, output and entry

topics.name: Money, Banking and Inflation
topics.summary: What money is and does, the institutions that create and regulate it, and what happens when prices rise.

subtopics.name: Money and Its Functions
subtopics.summary: The evolution of money, its qualities and functions, and the demand for and supply of money.

objectives.text: Trace the evolution of money from trade by barter
State the functions and qualities of good money
Explain the motives for holding money and the money supply

subtopics.name: Banking and Financial Institutions
subtopics.summary: Commercial banks, the Central Bank of Nigeria, development banks and the capital market.

objectives.text: State the functions of commercial banks and how they create credit
State the functions of the Central Bank of Nigeria
Distinguish the money market from the capital market

subtopics.name: Inflation and Deflation
subtopics.summary: Types and causes of inflation, how it is measured, its effects and how it is controlled.

objectives.text: Define inflation and classify it by rate and by cause
Compute a simple price index and an inflation rate
Analyse the effects of inflation on different groups
Describe monetary and fiscal measures for controlling inflation

topics.name: National Income and Public Finance
topics.summary: Measuring the total output of an economy, and how government raises and spends money.

subtopics.name: National Income
subtopics.summary: GDP, GNP, NNP and per capita income, the three measurement approaches and their difficulties.

objectives.text: Define GDP, GNP, NNP and per capita income
Compute national income aggregates from given data
Describe the output, income and expenditure approaches and their problems

subtopics.name: Public Finance and the Budget
subtopics.summary: Government revenue and expenditure, the budget, public debt and fiscal policy.

objectives.text: List the sources of government revenue and heads of expenditure
Distinguish balanced, surplus and deficit budgets
Explain public debt and the instruments of fiscal policy

subtopics.name: Taxation
subtopics.summary: Direct and indirect taxes, tax systems, the canons of taxation and tax incidence.

objectives.text: Distinguish direct from indirect taxes with Nigerian examples
Compare progressive, proportional and regressive tax systems
State the canons of taxation and explain tax incidence

topics.name: International Trade and the Nigerian Economy
topics.summary: Why countries trade, how the balance of payments works, and the structure and problems of Nigeria's economy.

subtopics.name: International Trade and Balance of Payments
subtopics.summary: Comparative advantage, terms of trade, protection, the balance of payments and exchange rates.

objectives.text: Explain absolute and comparative advantage as the basis for trade
Distinguish balance of trade from balance of payments and its accounts
Describe instruments of protection and measures to correct a BOP deficit

subtopics.name: The Nigerian Economy
subtopics.summary: Agriculture, petroleum and industrialisation in Nigeria, and the policies used to develop them.

objectives.text: Describe the role and problems of agriculture in Nigeria
Explain the place of petroleum in the Nigerian economy
Evaluate Nigeria's industrialisation strategies and economic reforms

sources.title: JAMB Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination Economics Syllabus
